question: True or false: in 2002 the US Congress declared Antonio Meucci the inventor of the telephone?
answer: False. Only the House of Representatives acted, with a resolution that has no force of law: it honoured Meucci and said his work in the invention of the telephone should be acknowledged. It noted that had he paid $10 to keep his 1871 notice of invention alive, Bell's patent could not have been issued.
move: Before repeating what a body declared, read what the document says.
trap: Mistaking a one-chamber resolution, retold in headlines, for a legal ruling.
reference: US House of Representatives, H.Res. 269, 107th Congress, 2002
